title: History of the Internet
text: The internet originated from ARPANET, a U.S. Department of Defense project in the late 1960s that developed packet-switching networking. The first ARPANET message was sent on October 29, 1969. Tim Berners-Lee invented the World Wide Web in 1989 while working at CERN in Switzerland, creating HTTP, HTML, and URLs. The commercialization of the internet in the 1990s led to explosive growth, with the number of internet users growing from about 16 million in 1995 to over 5 billion today. Email, search engines, social media, and e-commerce have fundamentally transformed communication, commerce, and culture. The internet is considered one of the most transformative technologies in human history.
